extraction.notes: Three-month 2023 column from the FFO/Core FFO/Core AFFO reconciliation (page 11). Share count 119,833 thousand (FFO weighted average common shares and units - diluted) reproduces reported per-share figures: 258,316/119,833=2.16; 274,892/119,833=2.29; 238,524/119,833=1.99. Zero-amount lines for Q3 2023 (shown as dashes) are included with amount 0: gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate (category 'other'), legal costs (legal), COVID-19 costs (other), and mark-to-market debt adjustment (debt_cost_amortization, the closest fit). Loss on investments in the EBITDA re table (6,547) differs from the net-of-tax 5,166 used in the FFO reconciliation; the FFO table figure was used. Core AFFO subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. FAD items after Core AFFO were excluded.
